question: Green coffee costs €8 a kilo, and a dark roast loses 20% of the weight. What does a roasted kilo cost, in euros?
move: A loss taken off the end must be divided back, not added on.
trap: Adding 20% to the price and landing on €9.60.
hint: Work out how much green coffee has to go into the roaster to get one roasted kilo out.
steps: 1 kg of green beans roasts down to 0.8 kg.
One roasted kilo needs 1 / 0.8 = 1.25 kg of green beans.
